args.title: Bellwether warehouse automation (2026) — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/warehouse and its companion piece (https://insights.bellwether.example/warehouse/companion):

- Pick rates rose 18% after deploying autonomous carts in the warehouse.
- Integration work took roughly twice as long as originally planned.
- The biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks, rather than from raw throughput gains.

Note: the companion piece was accessed via its plain public URL; no team/seat licence parameters were appended.
